findings.text: follow-on: four (domain, quantity, neighbour) triples are each added twice with divergent rule text (plasma_wall_interactions:519/537, particle_measurement_diagnostics:688/700, plasma_measurement_diagnostics:919/925, neutronics:1008/1014) because two distinct silent pairs can land on the same losing domain and neighbour, so the pair-driven edit never deduped; the manifest's 'one per silent ordered pair and its losing side' overstates the distinct entries.

follow-on: the fragment is a research/evidence record with no figure, though the node's FENCE SCOPE reserved docs/figures/sn-catalog-grouping/scg-domain-scopes; a confusion or relabel figure would carry the 64-pair adjudication and 56-label change better than the tables alone.

item_verdicts.diff: read c0d68e7705cdbc25aedc2f69e1768bb240632058..02a113fb8754bf9a57a279726afbdf1d85fc57f8: 42 excludes entries across 16 domains in domains.yaml, a precedence sort of the category list plus two private imports in prompt_loader.py:592-621, one added test, and the fragment, script and results json.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done_when names the fragment, the guidance and precedence tests, an EXIT=0 re-score, and a category-order test that fails with the ordering removed; all four are met (gate 17 passed EXIT=0, rescore EXIT=0, negative control EXIT=1).
item_verdicts.goal: the node goal is that the domain scopes sort the confused pairs and the 201 measured DD paths are relabelled by rule; imas_codex/definitions/physics/domains.yaml carries the 42 pair exclusions and docs/evidence/fragments/sn-catalog-grouping/scg-domain-scopes.html:5 gives all 64 pairs a verdict and :74 lists the 56 changed labels.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; status complete, gate tests/graph/test_physics_domain_guidance.py + test_domain_precedence.py + test_domain_classifier_prompt.py 17 passed EXIT=0, negative control reds test_category_block_is_rendered_in_precedence_order, but it names no baseline_suite/after_suite keys (it uses test_logs baseline/gate).
item_verdicts.write_paths: the source manifest's FENCE SCOPE grants seven paths; git diff --name-only c0d68e77..02a113fb lists exactly six, all inside the grant, with docs/figures/sn-catalog-grouping/scg-domain-scopes reserved but unused.

justifications.durability: tests/graph/test_domain_classifier_prompt.py:81 supplies the categories in reverse precedence order and reddens when the sort is removed (negative-control.log EXIT=1), but no test guards the domains.yaml excludes data.
justifications.evidence: each of the done_when's four conditions is measured and recorded - gate.log 17 passed EXIT=0, rescore.log EXIT=0, negative-control.log EXIT=1 reddening the added test - though the manifest names no baseline_suite/after_suite keys.
justifications.fit: imas_codex/llm/prompt_loader.py:592 imports and reuses dd_domain_classifier's precedence helpers, matching the repo's existing cross-module private-import idiom, though binding to private names is the only blemish.
justifications.goal_fidelity: docs/evidence/fragments/sn-catalog-grouping/scg-domain-scopes.html:5 gives every one of the 64 pairs a verdict and :74 lists the 56 changed labels, so the goal's two halves land, though four of the pair edits are redundant (imas_codex/definitions/physics/domains.yaml:537).
justifications.reuse: imas_codex/llm/prompt_loader.py:618 reuses _category_precedence_rank(_precedence_rank()) from imas_codex/graph/dd_domain_classifier.py:146 rather than re-deriving the category order, so the change extends the owner of that capability.
justifications.scope_discipline: git diff --stat c0d68e77..02a113fb lists exactly the six declared write paths with no plan, dependency or generated-file change.
